verdict.rationale: Increase documents its account model, separating Accounts from Account Numbers in a one-to-many mapping. It references FBO accounts in a customer story, and it offers FDIC coverage via IntraFi network banks and sweeps to FDIC-insured institutions. A community note says the underlying accounts sit at partner banks (First Internet Bank / Blue Ridge Bank). However, nothing plainly explains whether customer funds sit in pooled FBO or individual accounts, or how pass-through FDIC insurance attaches. missing for 10: plain documentation of FBO-pool vs individual-account structure, where FDIC insurance legally attaches (pass-through coverage), ledger visibility and access controls, independent corroboration.
